calls.statement:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT 'LY' p, period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=1
  UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=1),
lfl AS (
  SELECT st.store_id FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN per GROUP BY st.store_id, st.store_id HAVING st.store_id < 900
  ),
sales AS (
  SELECT per.p, st.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e WHERE st.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT per.p, st.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net, false FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e WHERE st.store_id < 900),
ok AS (SELECT store_id FROM sales GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(DISTINCT p)=2),
res AS (SELECT p, sum(amt) net_sales, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN amt END) net_ex_staff, count(DISTINCT store_id) n FROM sales WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ok) GROUP BY p)
SELECT t.n AS lfl_stores, l.net_sales AS ly, t.net_sales AS ty, round((t.net_sales/l.net_sales-1)*100,2) AS lfl_pct,
 round((t.net_ex_staff/l.net_ex_staff-1)*100,2) AS lfl_pct_ex_staff,
 round(((t.net_sales/28)/(l.net_sales/27)-1)*100,2) AS per_trading_day_pct
FROM res t JOIN res l ON t.p='TY' AND l.p='LY'
